cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: A Necessary Heartbreak
cards.instruction: Describe disappointment, rejection, or loss as the exact experience everyone needed in order to grow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm sorry I broke your graduation mug. You never did take to my lesson about letting things go. Perhaps this is what we needed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You still want the keepsake to do the remembering for you. Your degree's safe. Put the glue down; let the broken handle teach you something.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then give me your graduation mug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, hold me to it. Take mine; I'll learn to mean what I say. Show me which jam jar to drink from tomorrow.
